title: Todd Bowles says Buccaneers are "angrily optimistic" after 0-2 start

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Bowles says Buccaneers are "angrily optimistic" after 0-2 start
sources.description: The Buccaneers fell to 0-2 with Sunday's loss to the Browns and the team is now 2-9 since opening last season with a 6-2 record.
